This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sachin Shankar Magadum
 Oral Order
This petition is filed by accused No.1/husband and in-laws of respondent No.2/daughter-in-law
seeking quashing of the proceedings pending in CC.No.323/2025 for the offences punishable under
Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of Ipc.
2.

Respondent No.2/wife is present before this Court and has acknowledged the contents of the joint
affidavit placed on record.

The learned counsel appearing for Respondent No.2 has duly identified
her.

On being specifically queried by the Court, she submits that for the past one year she has been
residing with her husband - Petitioner No.1 and that she has returned to the matrimonial home
pursuant to the compromise Nc: 2025:Khc:35376 Hc-Kar recorded in the restitution of conjugal
rights proceedings pending before the Shivamogga Court.
3.

In view of the submissions made by Respondent No.2 and having regard to the fact that the
parties have resumed cohabitation and are living together as husband and wife for the past one year,
this Court finds that the continuance of criminal proceedings would serve no useful purpose.

Although the application filed under Section 320(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure is not
maintainable in so far as it relates to the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Ipc, this
Court, being satisfied that the wife has voluntarily rejoined her husband and that the parties are
presently leading a peaceful marital life, is of the opinion that, in order to prevent abuse of the
process of law and to secure the ends of justice, indulgence under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. deserves to
be granted.
4.

Accordingly, this Court proceeds to pass the following:
Order
(i) The Criminal Petition is allowed.
